author: Oilerator
body: Hello this is a appeal for my friend Knight187 that got banned for hacking on your server these are his words. He cannot do it himself, because when he try's to make a forum account it just says waiting after he join the specified server. These are his words why he wishes to get unbanned. I realize hacking is wrong it ruins the game for other players, and it is a game about blocks. I never knew why I hacked that day because I'm really good at PvP and stuff when I'm not hacking. I wish I never hacked on your server it is wrong to hack and I hate hackers my self. I hate myself for that one day I hacked on your great server. I would kindly like to be unbanned because hacking is wrong and I don't know why I ever did it. I hope you see and respond to this appeal and see how sorry I am for hacking your server -Sincerely Knight187 (My in game name is Knight187 if I do get unbanned^-^)

title: Knight187's Appeal (By Oilerator)

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
Hey Oilerator
As much as we appreciate the apology we only accept appeals for hacking after 6-8 months typically
for this reason your appeal is denied

~Pizza

Will lock in 24 hours or once requested.
